baslik: What Actually Makes a Volcano Explode
aciklama:
A volcano is a bottle of shaken soda the size of a mountain. Here is what makes it blow.

#shorts #science #volcano #nature #howitworks

sahneler.metin: A volcano is a giant bottle of shaken soda made of rock.
Deep below, molten rock rises toward the surface.
Dissolved gas is trapped inside it under crushing pressure.
As it rises, the pressure drops and the gas wants out.
Thick, sticky magma traps that gas instead of letting it escape.
Pressure builds until the whole thing lets go at once.
Rock, ash, and gas blast out faster than a jet.
Runny lava oozes; sticky lava explodes - that is the difference.
The mountain was calm because the pressure had nowhere to go, yet.
